    LargeIndecomposable.AR.PreprojComp.unbounded

    Preprojective components of unbounded representation length #

    If a connected algebra with a preprojective component containing a module has indecomposables of unbounded dimension, then the component itself has members of unbounded dimension (PreprojComp.unbounded): a component of bounded length is a closed class, hence contains every indecomposable (all_of_closed).

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.AR.PreprojComp.unbounded {k A : Type u} [Field k] [Ring A] [Algebra k A] [FiniteDimensional k A] {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (e : ι → A) (he : ∀ (x : ι), IsIdempotentElem (e x)) (hsum : ∑ x : ι, e x = 1) (hP : ∀ (x : ι), IndNT (projE ⋯)) (hconn : ∀ (S : Set ι), S.Nonempty → (∀ (x y : ι), x ∈ S → ((∃ (a : A), e x * a * e y ≠ 0) ∨ ∃ (a : A), e y * a * e x ≠ 0) → y ∈ S) → S = Set.univ) {𝒞 : FDMod k A → Prop} (h𝒞 : PreprojComp 𝒞) (hunb : ∀ (b : ℕ), ∃ (N : FDMod k A), IndNT N ∧ b < Module.finrank k N.carrier) (b : ℕ) :
    ∃ (X : FDMod k A), 𝒞 X ∧ b < Module.finrank k X.carrier

    A preprojective component of a connected algebra of unbounded length is unbounded.
